The '''Squid''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the ocean at [[The Beach]] or on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] in the evening during [[Winter]]. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Winter, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|80}}. Squid can be caught during the entire day on Winter 12th and 13th during the [[SquidFest]] festival. [[Pierre]] sells five Squid for {{Price|10|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each during the [[Desert Festival]]. When placed in a [[Fish Pond]], Squid will produce [[Squid Ink]] instead of [[Roe]], although Squid Roe can be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after obtaining the power from the [[Jewels Of The Sea]] book. Squid can be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]]. ==Map== The Squid can be found in the ocean. {{Map|275|200}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Maru,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Krobus |neutral=Demetrius,Sebastian,Linus,Willy,Leo |hate=Pierre,Evelyn,Pam,Haley |like=Elliott }} ==Bundles== Squid is not used in any bundles. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header|hide=buff,duration}} {{:Fried Calamari|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Maki Roll|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Quality Fertilizer|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Sashimi|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Squid can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Sailor Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt259a.png|24px]] ==Fish Pond== Squid can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 3 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing two quests. Instead of producing [[Roe]], squid ponds produce [[Squid Ink]].
